ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensure that the format of the IBAN iscorrectly captured by User, and follow the finnish format. This rule can be bypassed by a User by checking the field 'BypassVR' on its account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISPICKVAL( ER_BUPicklist__c, 'FI'), NOT(LEN(ER_IBAN__c) = 0), NOT( OR( AND(LEN( ER_IBAN__c ) <= 34, NOT(BEGINS(ER_IBAN__c, 'FI') )) , REGEX( ER_IBAN__c , "FI[0-9]{16}") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The format of Finnish IBAN starts with ‘FI’ and is followed by 16 digits. If the bank account is not from Finland, the IBAN can contain max 34 alphanumeric characters
